decisions.reason: The direct message-204 MODIFY already records the new terminal language and the constraint to preserve the Hero V hierarchy, elevation, and non-terminal geometry.
The direct message-204 MODIFY already records that the É accent must duplicate the terminal selected through the Hero V exploration without independent interpretation.
The direct message-204 MODIFY already records proportional construction from the Hero V, the restrained supporting role, and proportional transfer of the selected terminal.
The direct message-204 MODIFY already captures the paired columns, three reference guides, six terminal treatments, and identical-artwork comparison constraint.
Message 204 reiterates the existing exact peak-alignment rule without changing its current value.
Message 204 preserves the already-established hierarchy in which the second V remains above the alphabet and subordinate to the Hero V; it does not establish a new height value.
The instruction to leave every other element identical freezes the E and L during this exploration but does not change their architectural letterform state.
The source isolates terminal treatment and leaves spacing unchanged, so the selected Balanced Flow kerning remains valid without a state change.
